gloss: to scrape off; to shave off; to pare away

definitions.gloss: to scrape off; to shave off; to pare away
definitions.explanation: Physically removing material by scraping or shaving

definitions.gloss: to cut away; to whittle down; to reduce
definitions.explanation: Figurative: gradually removing or reducing something

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いペンキを{削|けず}り{取|と}る。
ナイフで{木|き}の{表面|ひょうめん}を{削|けず}り{取|と}った。
examples.english: I shaved off the surface of the wood with a knife.

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}が{岩|いわ}の{表面|ひょうめん}を{少|すこ}しずつ{削|けず}り{取|と}っていく。
examples.english: The ice gradually scrapes away the rock surface.

examples.japanese: {経費|けいひ}を{削|けず}り{取|と}る。
{競争|きょうそう}が{利益|りえき}を{削|けず}り{取|と}っている。
{無駄|むだ}な{部分|ぶぶん}を{削|けず}り{取|と}って、{文章|ぶんしょう}をすっきりさせた。
examples.english: I pared away the unnecessary parts and made the writing cleaner.

notes:
A compound verb combining {削|けず}る (to scrape/shave) + {取|と}る (to take), emphasizing the complete removal of material. Transitive verb.

TRANSITIVITY: transitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペンキを{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to scrape off paint
- {表面|ひょうめん}を{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to scrape off the surface
- {経費|けいひ}を{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to cut away expenses
- {利益|りえき}を{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to eat into profits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {削|けず}る: to scrape/shave — the base verb; doesn't emphasize complete removal
- {剥|は}がす: to peel off — removing a layer or coating by peeling rather than scraping
- {切|き}り{取|と}る: to cut off — removing by cutting rather than scraping
